reruns.allowedAfter: only an attempt not completed whose receipt has rerun "eligible": for the model only when that attempt has no verdict, and with a verdict the kit sets not-eligible; for the baseline also when it has the verdict failed, because the baseline is deterministic and its expected result is declared before the run; after a completed attempt there is no rerun in either mode, also when the baseline did not pass the comparison of section 9, and then there is no model run under this commitment; an attempt without a receipt allows no rerun; a refusal before any network call is not a run and is no attempt. The kit sets eligible when the run stopped before its first pass (list probe, list version or row assembly), at any error class; when a list request in a pass failed after retries with a network error, a timeout, HTTP 429 or 5xx, its response could not be parsed, or the list version did not match, and the rows before the stop would have passed the invalid check without the rows lost to the provider connection; or when model provider requests failed after retries with a network error, a timeout, HTTP 429 or 5xx and the pass would have completed without those rows
